mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 10% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in stronger earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 10.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.2 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the mean return in triggered periods is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a contraction in real economic activity, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 12.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls below 400,000.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in the unemployment rate signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 130000.0 and UNRATE < 15.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 255.0 signals rising inflation expectations that prompt the Fed to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 18,900 billion dollars signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 18,900.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
